purpose: Ids a route exposes for a model that models.dev publishes under a different id. Each row says the alias id IS the target row's model, so catalog.get serves the target's current facts under the alias id and marks every rate as borrowed. Served at read time only; nothing here is written to the store.
why_this_is_curated_rather_than_inferred: Two ids that look alike are not evidence of one model: a plugin can route one tier of an id to a different backend (antigravity-gemini-3.5-flash sends its high tier to gemini-3-flash-agent). So a row goes in only when someone has read the routing code and seen EVERY tier of the alias id reach the target's own backend model, and the row cites the file and revision that was read.
prices_through_an_alias: Rates served through an alias are the target's API list price, carried so a consumer can relate a subscription route to what the same model costs on the API. They are marked inherited_from with basis alias and never presented as the route's own published price.
how_to_add_a_row: Read the routing code at a pinned revision. Include the alias only if every reasoning tier resolves to the target's own backend model id and the target exists in the embedded models.dev seed. Record the revision in source_ref, the day you read it in established_at_ms, and review_by_ms 60 days later. A near miss belongs in the declared-exclusions list in src/aliases.rs with its reason, not here.

aliases.basis: ALL_MODEL_DEFINITIONS exposes antigravity-claude-sonnet-5-5 with low, medium and high variants and limits context: 1000000, output: 128000; ANTIGRAVITY_OPENCODE_MODEL_IDS includes it. The native claude-sonnet-5-5-low, -medium and -high entries all declare vertexModelId: 'claude-sonnet-5-5@default', so every tier reaches the same Anthropic model and the suffix selects only its thinking level. resolveModelWithTier maps the bare id to actualModel: `${modelWithoutQuota}-low`, tier: 'low'.

aliases.basis: The resolver recognises the id as Argon and resolves every tier through getGeminiArgonAntigravityModel: low, medium and high go to gemini-4-argon-low, -medium and -high, and a missing or unknown tier defaults to gemini-4-argon-medium. RESOLVER_ALIASES maps each of those back to gemini-4-argon, so the suffix spells a reasoning level and every request reaches Google's gemini-4-argon.
